selection: Fixed replacements for environmental failures; superseded failures excluded; semantic failures not selectively retried.
timing: Per-query execution time, excluding graph loading.
recording: Selected recorded model outputs, rescored with canonical answer-set semantics.
scoring: Paper canon_q: compare sets of canonical answer instances; equivalent repeated groups count once. Accuracy and F1 average all 450 queries. Missing, unfinished or invalid outputs score zero; explicit empty/empty scores one.
rounding: Display decimals to two places. Compute aggregate metrics before row rounding.

paper_error_analysis.definition: Unfinished at the 300-second or 160-request budget cap.
